news.h: Jayden Daniels, Commanders 'keep fighting through adversity,' improve to 2-4-1
news.d: After falling behind 10-0 in the first half, quarterback Jayden Daniels led the Washington Commanders on a rousing rally, cruising to a 27-10 win over the Philadelphia Eagles at Northwest Stadium, an effort in which he threw for 217 yards and a touchdown.

news.h: Jayden Daniels throws TD pass and Commanders shut out Eagles over final 3 quarters in 27-10 win
news.d: — The Washington Commanders had just under two weeks to sit with their disheartening start to the season before their matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.
